name: slowmo
caption:
3 TEAMS, 1 SEASON 🎮🏀 3 teams last season. Now he's ours.

• High school: his coach called him a modern-day Magic Johnson
• 2014 draft: #30 to San Antonio
• Since then: Memphis, Minnesota, Golden State, Miami, Utah: 7 franchises counting us
• July 2, 2026: 1-year minimum deal with us
• His first 9 games with us: 7.6 minutes a night

More minutes for Slow Mo? 👇

facts.claim: Anderson nicknamed Slow Mo; high school coach Bob Hurley called him a modern-day Magic Johnson; 2014 NBA draft #30 (30th overall) by the San Antonio Spurs; career history: Spurs, Grizzlies, Timberwolves, Warriors, Heat, Jazz, Raptors (7 franchises); 2025-26: Utah Jazz, then traded to Memphis, waived and signed with Minnesota (3 teams); July 2, 2026: 1-year minimum deal with Toronto
